author: github:@newcomer-05
title: fix: memory leak in worker pool
body:
Closes #128.

Adds TOML loading behind the same interface as the YAML loader, with a shared conformance test run against both formats.

Scope of this change: only `src/pool.py`, see report 4.
diff:
-    while True:
-        task = queue.get()
+    while not self._stop.is_set():
+        try:
+            task = queue.get(timeout=0.1)
+        except Empty:
+            continue

author: github:@newcomer-08
title: perf: cache resolved imports
body:
Refs #149.

Split the 900-line parser into three modules with no behaviour change. The existing test suite passes unchanged, which is the proof that the refactor is behaviour-preserving.

Scope of this change: only `src/client.py`, see report 7.
diff:
-    return self._resolve(name)
+    if name in self._cache:
+        return self._cache[name]
+    self._cache[name] = self._resolve(name)
+    return self._cache[name]

author: github:@newcomer-09
title: fix: race in shutdown handler
body:
Fixes #156.

The worker pool was not joining on shutdown, so threads leaked on SIGTERM. Now it sets the stop event and joins with a timeout. Added a test that spawns and tears down the pool 50 times.

Scope of this change: only `src/paginator.py`, see report 8.
diff:
-    self._thread.start()
+    self._thread = threading.Thread(target=self._run, daemon=True)
+    self._thread.start()

author: github:@newcomer-02
title: feat: add retry with backoff to client
body:
Closes #107.

My benchmark took 4.2s on the 10k-row fixture; after the change it is 1.1s. I kept the change local to the resolver cache and added a test for the cache-miss path so the fast path is not the only one covered.

Scope of this change: only `src/client.py`, see report 1.
diff:
-    result = self._fetch(url)
+    for attempt in range(self.retries):
+        try:
+            return self._fetch(url)
+        except TransientError:
+            sleep(2 ** attempt)
+    raise TransientError(url)
